name: map_normalClosure
statement: Set G) (f : G →* N) (hf : Surjective f) : (normalClosure s).map f = normalClosure (f '' s)

name: comap_normalClosure
statement: Set N) (f : G ≃* N) : normalClosure (f ⁻¹' s) = (normalClosure s).comap f

name: SubgroupNormal.mem_comm
statement: Subgroup G} (hK : H ≤ K) [hN : (H.subgroupOf K).Normal] {a b : G} (hb : b ∈ K) (h : a * b ∈ H) : b * a ∈ H

have_tree.body: (normal_subgroupOf_iff hK).mp hN (a * b) b h hb

name: normalClosure_eq_top_of
statement: Subgroup G} [hn : N.Normal] {g g' : G} {hg : g ∈ N} {hg' : g' ∈ N} (hc : IsConj g g') (ht : normalClosure ({⟨g, hg⟩} : Set N) = ⊤) : normalClosure ({⟨g', hg'⟩} : Set N) = ⊤
